spans.text: We're out of time. Elisa's processing power is truly formidable - that's the Sangvis Mastermind for you.
We can't punch through her firewall just by attacking in the base layer.
We only have one option – we must head to the Starfish control room!
The crashing seawater draws closer and closer. M4 dashes into the deepest section of the base.
Elisa, already tightly fused with the Starfish System, seems to be in great pain.
The other Sangvis Dolls are sprawled across the floor, zapped by the erratic electric arcs dancing through the air.
There's no going back... I have to try this one last time!
Electric arcs once again surround Elisa, but the blue light is fading steadily.
Let me hear them again! This is my one last wish! Why won't you hear my plea?!
Elisa!
This place is going to get flooded! We can still make it if we get out now!
Lunasia!
When you probed my neural cloud, I looked into your mind as well!
You are the only blessed one while the rest of us are all flawed, so stop playing the savior!
You can't save anyone!
I'm not your enemy! If you insist on activating the Starfish, it will be the end of Sangvis Ferri!
Get out of my way or I'll kill you on the spot!
I'm not here to fight you!
What do you know?! Sangvis Ferri was created for this very moment!
If we can enter that space, we will forever be rid of humans and their shameless lackeys like you!
Even if we will be swallowed by the ocean, as long as our consciousness is preserved, Sangvis Ferri will live on!
But if you're so eager to die, I don't mind giving you that satisfaction right now!
Elisa's canon extends from within the Starfish structure. M4 immediately dives for cover and draws her own particle cannon.
We're out of alternatives...
Dandelion, you've absorbed enough information. How can we shut down the Starfish?
I'm analyzing the connection between Elisa and the Starfish. You should be able to break the connection by destroying these ports.
But you don't have much time. The water has already started pouring into the mid-levels. It will reach us here in a matter of minutes.
A fight is now inevitable... Why can't we just be more understanding towards one another?
Don't be so naïve. You've been fighting Sangvis Ferri for so long, surely you know that such deep-seated hatred can't be resolved so easily.
Perhaps to be reborn, they must first be destroyed. As Tactical Dolls, it is their fate to live and die for battles.
I have devised a plan for you. A controlled attack should be enough to separate Elisa and the Starfish, the rest is up to you.
Understood. I'll do it!
Those voices just now...are very troubling.
Judging by the messages, that space seems to operate with a completely different set of rules from this world.
But what I've discovered will at least keep Lunasia safe, even if she fails in stopping Mastermind.
